panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Clinical photograph of a SAVI patient showing a chilblain-like acral nodule, a recognized SAVI cutaneous manifestation. B: Clinical photograph of a SAVI patient showing a chilblain lesion on the thumb, consistent with SAVI pernio-like acral lesions.

in_text_mentions: At 17 years of age, the mother of our index patient (P2) presented with reddish skin lesions on the dorsal side of her hands and feet which became increasingly painful nodules (Fig. 3A, B). A skin biopsy showed sparse dermal inflammatory infiltration resembling systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) or chilblain lupus. At 19 years of age, she started developing arthralgias of her hand and feet about three months after delivery with stiffness and swelling in her fingers and toes, especially the proximal interphalangeal joints. findings.label: Facial erythematous rash
findings.evidence: Visual evidence of facial tissue changes in the proband's father.

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 5 panels (A, B, C, D, E). A: Panel A shows clubbing fingers of the proband, which is a clinical sign of the disease. B: Panel B shows the pigeon breast deformity of the proband. C: Panel C shows the facial rash of the proband, consistent with SAVI facial eruptions. D: Panel D shows clubbing fingers in the father, a known feature of the systemic nature of SAVI. E: Panel E shows facial tissue loss/damage in the father, aligning with severe manifestations of SAVI.

in_text_mentions: (SpO2) was 67% in room air. Chest auscultation revealed fine crackles in the posterior lung fields. Clubbing fingers, pigeon breast deformity, and chilblain-like rash on her face were observed (Fig. 1A, B, C). Her anterior fontanelle was not closed (0.3 cm×0.3 cm). Other cutaneous manifestations were not observed. The patient displayed a height of 87 cm (-1.08 SD) and a weight of 11.5 kg (-0.82 SD).
